ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  BirlaNu Limited has received National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Hyderabad Bench approval for the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Clean Coats Private Limited, a strategic move aimed at realizing significant operational and administrative synergies. This merger, which involves no new share issuance for BirlaNu, will streamline group operations and expand the company's product portfolio. However, the scheme's effectiveness is contingent on receiving the pending NCLT Mumbai Bench sanction for Clean Coats Private Limited.
